contributions.statement: Half of public SKILL.md files are byte-for-byte copies, so a team sharing skills across repos needs one source of truth with versioned sync rather than copy-paste.
contributions.evidence: §III item 3: 50.5% exact copies by content hash; no breakdown of template vs organic reuse.
relative_to: single source of truth / dependency management for shared config (known)

reason: A 3-page dataset release; it measures adoption and copying but nothing about whether skills help, and the one implication is ordinary config hygiene.
